  definition netAssetsExHome equals netAssets - residence
anchors.quote:
3.3 “Net assets” refers to the value that is calculated by deducting total liabilities from total
assets. “Net assets, excluding primary residence” refers to the value that is calculated
by deducting the value of primary residence from net assets.

assumptions: Inputs are complete, correctly classified HKD money amounts as stipulated; classification, attribution, exchange conversion and SPI eligibility are outside scope.
Subtractions retain negative results: paragraph 3.3 supplies no zero floor.
The synthetic validity interval is handled by the host and does not alter the arithmetic.
interpretation: Net assets equal total assets minus total liabilities. Net assets excluding primary residence equal net assets minus the supplied primary residence value.
source:
```catala
scope NetAssets:
  definition netAssets equals assets - liabilities
  definition netAssetsExHome equals netAssets - residence
```
